newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bank of Baroda cuts prime to 14.0pct.
newsitem.headline: India Bank of Baroda cuts prime to 14.0pct.

text.p: India's state-run Bank of Baroda will cut its prime lending rate (PLR) to 14.0 percent from 14.5 percent, effective April 21, the bank's chairman K.Kannan said on Friday.
He said the range at which the bank lends to customers is spread over 3.5 percent above PLR.
State Bank of India, the country's largest commercial bank, cut its PLR to 14 percent from 14.5 on Tuesday, hours after the Reserve Bank of India announced its credit policy for 1997/98.
